name: Banana Curry
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ tsp garam masala or good curry powder

steps: Add milk, cream, garam masala (or curry) powder, chili, and lemon (add some salt) to the bananas.
Melt butter, add cumin seeds and turmeric, and cook at medium low for a couple of minutes until a fragrant smell develops.
Cook on a gentle flame until ready (depends on banana's ripeness)—do not overcook.

culture.text: Curry is a dish with a spicy sauce, initially in Indian cuisine, then modified by interchange with the Portuguese, followed by the British, and eventually thoroughly internationalised. Many curries are found in the cuisines of countries in Southeast Asia and East Asia.
